title: SFI welcomes 2026 External Professors
gist: The Santa Fe Institute added six new External Faculty in 2026, spanning international affairs, cognitive science, political science, ecology, physics, and behavioral economics, extending its interdisciplinary network into policy-relevant fields like AI, energy, and democratic institutions.

insights.claim: The Santa Fe Institute named six new External Faculty in 2026: Henry Farrell (Johns Hopkins, international affairs), Robert Goldstone (Indiana University Bloomington, psychological and brain sciences), Hahrie Han (Johns Hopkins, political science), Holly Moeller (UC Santa Barbara, ecology, evolution and marine biology), Washington Taylor (MIT, physics), and Elke Weber (Princeton, energy/environment and psychology).
insights.speaker: Santa Fe Institute
insights.so_what: The new cohort signals SFI is deepening ties into international affairs, political science, energy/climate policy, and physics, broadening the institutional and disciplinary reach of its complex-systems research network beyond its traditional physics/biology core.
insights.quote: This year, six new researchers joined SFI’s External Faculty
insights.locator: This year, six new researchers joined SFI's External Faculty

insights.claim: External Faculty are described by the Santa Fe Institute as central to its identity as a research institute, enriching its interaction networks and connecting it to more than 70 institutions worldwide.
insights.speaker: Santa Fe Institute
insights.so_what: SFI's model relies on a distributed network of affiliated scholars across 70+ institutions rather than a large in-house faculty, which is how it sustains interdisciplinary complexity-science research and cross-pollination with fields like AI and policy.
insights.quote: External Faculty are central to SFI’s identity as a world-class research institute. They enrich our networks of interactions, help us push the boundaries of complex-systems science, and connect us to more than 70 institutions around the globe.
insights.locator: External Faculty are central to SFI's identity

insights.claim: New SFI External Professor Elke Weber holds the Gerhard R. Andlinger Professorship in Energy and the Environment at Princeton and is also a professor of psychology and public affairs, linking behavioral science to energy-policy research.
insights.speaker: Santa Fe Institute
insights.so_what: Her dual appointment in behavioral psychology and energy/environment suggests SFI's complexity-science lens is being applied to decision-making under climate and energy transition pressures.
insights.quote: Gerhard R. Andlinger Professor in Energy and the Environment and Professor of Psychology and Public Affairs

insights.claim: New SFI External Professor Washington Taylor is a Professor of Physics at MIT, adding formal physics expertise to SFI's external network.
insights.speaker: Santa Fe Institute
insights.so_what: Reinforces SFI's continued investment in physics-grounded approaches to complex-systems theory alongside its social-science expansion.
insights.locator: Washington Taylor, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)
